summary: The change is now rebased onto `origin/main`, which already contains the sign-in allowlist and the desktop sign-out action. The diff adds the production `stagingTestersSecretId`, which `prod` points at the west allowlist, the `stagingAccess` session flag, and the desktop "Use Staging" toggle; it now also hides the toggle after a successful sign-out. The logic, infra and README all match prod keeping its own `halo-prod-sign-in-allowlist`. All temp tests pass, every changed line is covered, and no P0 or P1 issue remains.
